title: A day off work
instructions: İki iş arkadaşı izin günlerini değiştirmeye çalışıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; günleri ve anlaşmayı takip et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Mia, can I ask you a favour? I'm working on Saturday, but my brother is getting married that day.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Oh, congratulations! Do you want me to work for you?

script.speaker: a
script.text: If you can. I could work your Sunday shift in return.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Hmm, I'm visiting my parents on Sunday, so I don't need to work then anyway. What about next Wednesday?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Next Wednesday is fine. I usually have that day off.

script.speaker: b
script.text: OK. But I finish at six on Saturday. Is that OK? Your shift finishes at eight.

script.speaker: a
script.text: I'll ask Tom to do the last two hours.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Good. And you need to tell the manager by Thursday.

script.speaker: a
script.text: I'll email her today. Thank you so much!

questions.prompt: Why can't Jack work on Saturday?
questions.evidence: my brother is getting married that day.

questions.prompt: What does Mia do on Sunday?
questions.evidence: I'm visiting my parents on Sunday

questions.prompt: Which day will Jack work for Mia?
questions.feedback: Jack karşılığında gelecek çarşamba Mia'nın yerine çalışacak.

questions.prompt: Who will work the last two hours on Saturday?
questions.evidence: I'll ask Tom to do the last two hours.

questions.prompt: When must Jack tell the manager?
questions.evidence: you need to tell the manager by Thursday.
